newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end steady in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end steady in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange ended virtually unchanged in mixed trade on Thursday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 0.43 point higher at 796.09 points.
Brokers said shares of multinationals including Hindustan Lever and Brooke Bond India were in spotlight.
"Hectic activity in multi-national company shares was the main feature of the session," said B.K. Nagpal of brokers B.B. Portfolio.
Hindustan Lever surged 22.75 rupees to 1,082.75 on brisk buying by foreign institutional investors, brokers said.
Brooke Bond Lipton India gained 5.00 rupees to 430.00.
Reliance Industries lost 2.95 rupees to 295.65 as speculators and investors pocketed profits.
State Bank of India fell 1.80 rupees to 308.00.
